description: The open assumptions the tenable spec rests on, each with the acceptance criterion that depends on it (req-tenable-observe-10). The observation command marks each one settled, contradicted or not reached for the instance it read. A settled entry still needs the operator's review before any requirement that depends on it moves to Implemented.

assumptions.claim: An analysis page asked for [0, N) returns at most N records, with offsets sent both at the request root (documentation) and inside query (pyTenable).
On Security Center 6.2 and later, wasVuln=excludeWas is accepted as a filter.
The lastSeen filter takes the documented <minDaysBack>:<maxDaysBack> form.

A query with an unknown filter is refused with a message listing the valid filter names, which include repositoryIDs, pluginID, port, protocol, severity, familyID, exploitAvailable, cveID, asset, recastRiskStatus and lastSeen.
Every vulndetails record carries hostUniqueness (or uniqueness before 5.14), naming only fields from the known set.
Each repository's records carry one hostUniqueness list, stable within the repository.
Agent repositories name uuid (the agent UUID) in hostUniqueness, and not agentUUID.
Records carry lastMitigated (documented only as a filter name).
Records carry vulnUUID and vulnUniqueness (guaranteed from 6.7).
Records carry the plugin's cve string.
pluginText is wrapped in <plugin_output> tags.
The plugin read returns checkType values that tell remote checks from local ones.
Compliance results carry cm: elements in pluginText.
A query with no acceptRiskStatus filter excludes accepted results through the API, as it does in the query UI.
The repository list returns the four vulnerability lifetimes under the pinned fields.
The feed read returns active and passive entries with an updateTime.
The sumip tool returns the last authenticated and unauthenticated scan times and the OS CPE.
The individual view of a finished scan result returns its records.
A scan result's detail record (progress) names the scanners that ran it.
An organisation user's scanner list is narrowed to agent-capable scanners with few fields.
One plugin, port and IP does not appear both with and without a hostUUID.
A Director-managed or Enclave Security deployment can be told apart from a plain Security Center by the probe's reads.
The /hosts paging flag (not read in v0).
